_doc: Discord unicode emoji DB extracted from the client bundle by tools/probes/extract_emoji.py. emojis[i]: n=names (n[0] canonical shortcode, rest aliases), s=surrogates, v=unicodeVersion, u=Twemoji asset hash -> https://discord.com/assets/<u>.svg (empty: no image), sp=spriteIndex, dc=skin-tone children indices (tone1..5, or 25 for multi-person md=1), d=skin tone code points of a child. categories: picker order, [start, end) index ranges into emojis (children follow index 1932+). Search in the client matches names only (no separate keyword table).
